Edit the supplied board (image1) with strict functionality corrections while preserving its three-screen board format, existing backgrounds, art style, typography, and the complete left menu layout. Keep visible all UI with minimum safe margins, remove no required function. Second reference is EXISTING wolf icon to insert, not new art.

Envelope red unread dot, gear both retained. Add a compact wolf merchant area near lower-left yard with reference wolf portrait and green 买鸡50 / red 卖鸡40 side by side; must be above trading dock and not overlap incubator. Add small green 烤炉Lv.1→2 / 200金币 button at bakery, separate from cake65% bubble. Egg bubble collect and cake bubble sell stay by buildings, incubator has explicit 孵化1枚 action with egg icon (mutually exclusive with chick领取 state, do not show both as simultaneously available). Add tiny stored egg count 库存蛋2 by bakery. Remove misleading random chick4 bubble in yard. Trading dock title must say 当前股价, not 收盘股价 during play, include 持有3股 clearly, price186 ▲42, miniature chart, 买入 / 卖出, full width 结束今天. Show unobtrusive small 长按可连续操作. The character yard remains substantial, no overlap of bubbles and buttons.
RIGHT TUTORIAL SCREEN: same corrected underlying farm but dimmed inactive controls; tutorial title 一日入门 without incorrect 1/6 denominator. Change egg quantity to3, cake count0, no contradictory baking65% while teaching first egg. Keep egg target spotlight and 收集鸡蛋 / 点击鸡舍旁的鸡蛋气泡 / 已收集0/3 / 退出教程. Keep Chinese accurate, clean readable full screens; references' existing elements only.
dialogs: Edit this THREE-screen board faithfully, preserving layout, existing wood/cream art and palette and all settings controls. Functional audit corrections: MIDDLE farm task panel currently omits news. Reduce oversized goal blocks slightly to make room below goals for a slim prominent news strip with existing weather/sun icon and Chinese “今夜告示 · 狼商囤粮 ▲”; add small shortfall text under total wealth “还差1,600金币” and under flock “还差3只鸡”; maintain total1400/3000 and12/15, progressbars and both targets rule and 返回农场 button and X. RIGHT achievement panel must show actual unlock criteria under each title: 一日入门 subtitle “学完收蛋、孵化、烤蛋糕和买卖”; 第一块蛋糕 subtitle “把烤好的蛋糕换成金币”; 鸡舍开张 subtitle “从狼摊买来第一只鸡”; 进场交易 subtitle “买下第一股”; 十五只鸡 subtitle “同时养到15只鸡”. Keep first3 green checks, last2 尚未解锁. If necessary allow last row partially below scroll edge to signal more list, no new claim-rewards action. LEFT settings retain separate sound and ambience, language, 3 font sizes, replay tutorial, home menu and reset; add a very small “制作人：hhhhhnicaia@gmail.com” footer without pushing bottom button outside frame. Below screens add small design annotation “切换项保留选中／未选中状态；成就列表可滚动；任务达标时显示达标印章”. Preserve same3 panels and existing material style no new invented decorative elements.
reports: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished presentation board of THREE distinct full-height mobile game interface redesigns for 小鸡股市. Landscape high-resolution image, three equally sized 9:16 portrait screens side by side, slim cream gutters and small Chinese captions above each. Each screen represents logical 576x1024. Entire screens visible with generous safe margins, no phones or perspective. This is a concept layout using ONLY the existing reference game's visual vocabulary and elements: warm detailed painterly farm, exact recognizable chicken gold coin, eggs, cake, wood/brass framed cream panels, olive green primary buttons, terracotta red secondary danger buttons, serif-like friendly Chinese dark brown text. Recompose and resize the referenced elements faithfully, do not invent a new art direction, new buildings, new characters, new icon styles, modern flat blue controls, extra ornament, or features. Reference atlas checkerboard is NOT an element: never include checkerboard anywhere. Improve hierarchy: concise titles, large key numbers, consistent padding, fewer nested boxes, spacious clear buttons. Keep Chinese readable, spelled correctly, no lorem ipsum. These are complete opaque screen mockups, not runtime sprite assets. BOARD 3: all screens same dim blue night farm backdrop from reference4/5, moon above; cream parchment cards restructured with restrained wooden edge, consistent safe margin at bottom. Top-right little existing mail icon outside report remains accessible. NO farm dock on any settlement screen. Left caption 每日结算. Title 今日结算, small 第3天 → 第4天, single news strip 今夜告示 · 狼商囤粮 ▲. Dominant 收盘股价 186 with smaller green ▲42. Three compact equal statistics 2 碎蛋 / 3 长成 / 1 蛋糕 using existing icons, then 总资产 980 → 1,120, small 新孵1只，天亮后领取. Wide dominant green 开始新一天 anchored inside card with bottom padding, smaller beige 看广告回到清晨 beneath. Middle caption 八日通关. Small 八日总结 ribbon, large 动物街新贵, gold coin rank dots, green 双线达标 seal. Two equal statistics 总资产 3,240 / 目标3,000 and 鸡群 16 / 目标15; compact 八日资产 rising line chart and small 现金1,840 + 股票1,400. Bottom strong green 继续无尽模式, secondary beige 分享成绩 and 再挑战八天 side by side. Right caption 挑战未达标. Same layout system subdued warm palette rather than alarming red screen. Title 八日总结 then 差一点就达标. Two goal stats 总资产 2,480 / 3,000 and 鸡群 12 / 15, clearly show progress and 未达标 in muted terracotta. Compact fluctuating eight-day chart. Existing small chick near calm short message 下次再试试. Bottom dominant green 再挑战八天, secondary beige 分享成绩. These are illustrative sample outcomes, no new monetization or revival currencies. FUNCTIONAL AUDIT CORRECTIONS (override above wherever inconsistent): Both middle and right are SAME eight-day summary, one goals-met and one goals-unmet; NOT a separate loss mode. BOTH must include 继续无尽模式, 分享成绩, 再挑战八天. Both retain rank title and rank pips, wealth curve, cash/stock breakdown, comparison beat text small 超过 65% 的农场主 (illustrative), and missing/extra goal amounts. Right shows 还差520金币 and 还差3只鸡. Middle show 多出240金币 and 多出1只鸡. At bottom of whole board add small non-interface note “结算操作：等待3秒后解锁；无尽入口不受达标状态限制”. Top right of EVERY screen must retain both envelope and gear reachable above report, with a red unread dot on envelope. Daily report show weather icon alongside news, preserve both next-day and rewind buttons. Final report has no rewind button.
